locations.note: Guanajuato's coloured hillside houses and road tunnels are the map's city, with street races through the underground passages.
The Maya ruins of Ek' Balam, with the acropolis to climb by car, in the map's jungle corner.
Mulegé, the palm oasis town on the Gulf of California, the map's Baja village.
Copper Canyon's gorges and switchbacks, the map's western highlands.
The Baja desert and its dunes, the dry north of the map.
